title: Data-Driven Tooth Selection Enhances Partial-Mouth Periodontal Screening
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
The high prevalence of periodontitis has imposed a significant global disease burden. Epidemiologic surveys rely on full-mouth periodontal examination (FMPE) or partial-mouth periodontal examination (PMPE). While FMPE is resource-intensive, the efficiency ...
